histogram.name: CPU.Experimental.CpuEstimationTaskMigrated
histogram.summary:
True if the CPU estimation task was running on a different CPU at the end of the assembly loop than it was at the beginning.
Recorded when the CPU estimation task runs (every 5 minutes). Windows x86 only.

histogram.name: CPU.Experimental.CpuEstimationTaskQueuedTime.{CoreType}
histogram.summary:
The time in microseconds during which the CPU estimation task was queued before running.
Recorded when the CPU estimation task runs (every 5 minutes). Windows x86 only. Reported only on devices using the high resolution clock.

histogram.name: CPU.Experimental.CpuEstimationTaskThreadTime.{CoreType}
histogram.summary:
The thread time in microseconds it took to fully execute the CPU estimation task.
Recorded when the CPU estimation task runs (every 5 minutes). Windows x86 only. Reported only on devices using the high resolution clock.

histogram.name: CPU.Experimental.CpuEstimationTaskTotalTime.{CoreType}
histogram.summary:
The time in microseconds it took to fully execute the CPU estimation task, that is its queued time + the wall time elapsed before the task finished.
Recorded when the CPU estimation task runs (every 5 minutes). Windows x86 only. Reported only on devices using the high resolution clock.

histogram.name: CPU.Experimental.CpuEstimationTaskWallTime.{CoreType}
histogram.summary:
The wall time in microseconds it took to fully execute the CPU estimation task.
Recorded when the CPU estimation task runs (every 5 minutes). Windows x86 only. Reported only on devices using the high resolution clock.

histogram.name: CPU.Experimental.CpuEstimationThreadTimePercent.{CoreType}
histogram.summary:
The ratio of thread time vs wall time of the CPU estimation task's "running" portion, i.e. the thread time of the assembly loop divided by its wall time.
Recorded when the CPU estimation task runs (every 5 minutes). Windows x86 only.

histogram.name: CPU.Experimental.EstimatedFrequencyAsPercentOfLimit.{CoreType}
histogram.summary:
The CPU frequency as a percentage of the estimated current frequency (see base::EstimateCpuFrequency) over the max frequency of the fastest CPU, as reported by base::GetCpuMhzLimit.
Recorded when the CPU estimation task runs (every 5 minutes). Windows x86 only.

histogram.name: CPU.Experimental.EstimatedFrequencyAsPercentOfMax.{CoreType}
histogram.summary:
The CPU frequency as a percentage of the estimated current frequency (see base::EstimateCpuFrequency) over the max frequency of the fastest CPU, as reported by base::GetCpuMaxMhz.
Recorded when the CPU estimation task runs (every 5 minutes). Windows x86 only.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.AndroidSwapPressure.CheckOutcome
histogram.summary: The outcome of each swap-pressure evaluation in SwapPressureDiscardingPolicyAndroid (recorded once per rate-limited check on page lifecycle events). Used to normalize how often the policy triggers (DiscardedTabs / total checks), how often the file-cache gate suppresses false-positive swap-only triggers (SwapPressureOnly), and how often pressure is blocked by the minimum live-tab floor or candidate protection rules.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.AndroidSwapPressure.DiscardedTabCount
histogram.summary: Recorded when SwapPressureDiscardingPolicyAndroid attempts to urgently discard one or more eligible background tabs due to swap and file-cache pressure on Android. Logs the number of tabs discarded in that check (or 0 if the discard attempt did not succeed).

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.AndroidSwapPressure.DiscardedTabSessionOutcome
histogram.summary: Recorded once for each background tab proactively discarded by SwapPressureDiscardingPolicyAndroid, resolving its fate within the foreground browsing session in which it was discarded: whether the user switched back to it in the same foreground session (causing a visible reload), closed the tab without ever revisiting it ("free tab kill"), or backgrounded Chrome (ending the visible session) without ever revisiting it ("free tab kill").

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.AndroidSwapPressure.DiscardedTabTimeInBackground
histogram.summary: Recorded for each background tab urgently discarded by SwapPressureDiscardingPolicyAndroid. Measures how long the tab had been hidden in the background at the moment it was discarded.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.AndroidSwapPressure.DiscardedTabTimeToRevisit
histogram.summary: Recorded when a user switches back to a tab that was previously discarded by SwapPressureDiscardingPolicyAndroid. Measures the elapsed time between when the tab was proactively discarded and when it became visible again.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.AndroidSwapPressure.EstimatedReclaimedMb
histogram.summary: The total estimated private memory footprint (in MiB) of the background tabs discarded in a single SwapPressureDiscardingPolicyAndroid check. Recorded once per check that successfully discards at least one tab.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.AndroidSwapPressure.FileCacheMb
histogram.summary: The total file-backed page cache (Active(file) + Inactive(file) from /proc/meminfo) in MiB observed when SwapPressureDiscardingPolicyAndroid evaluates system swap pressure on Android and at least one pressure criterion (swap pressure or file-cache pressure) is active.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.AndroidSwapPressure.LiveTabCountAtPressure
histogram.summary: The number of non-discarded live tabs present in the PerformanceManager graph when both swap pressure and file-cache pressure gates are active on Android (recorded before applying the min_tabs_to_keep floor).

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.AndroidSwapPressure.SwapFreePercent
histogram.summary: The percentage of total swap space that is free (SwapFree / SwapTotal from /proc/meminfo) observed when SwapPressureDiscardingPolicyAndroid evaluates system swap pressure on Android and at least one pressure criterion (swap pressure or file-cache pressure) is active.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.Discarding.DecisionResult{Trigger}
histogram.summary:
Recorded every time the DiscardEligibilityPolicy evaluates a tab for discarding. Tracks whether the tab was Eligible, Protected (blocked by policy), or Disallowed.
This metric is recorded for all decisions, and broken down by the {Trigger} reason.

variant.name: .Frozen
variant.summary: Triggered by frozen tab growing memory

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.Discarding.HadFormInteraction
histogram.summary: Recorded at the moment a discard decision is made. This is recorded at the same time as PerformanceManager.Discarding.DecisionResult. Indicates if the tab had recorded form interactions.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.Discarding.HadUserEdits
histogram.summary: Recorded at the moment a discard decision is made. This is recorded at the same time as PerformanceManager.Discarding.DecisionResult. Indicates if the tab had recorded user edits (typing).

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.Discarding.ProtectionReason
histogram.summary: Recorded when a tab is marked as 'Protected' during a discard evaluation. This is recorded at the same time as PerformanceManager.Discarding.DecisionResult. Logs the specific reason (e.g., Audio, Form Interaction, Pinned) that prevented the discard.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.Discarding.TimeHiddenAtDecision
histogram.summary: Recorded at the moment a discard decision is made. This is recorded at the same time as PerformanceManager.Discarding.DecisionResult. Measures how long the tab has been hidden (in background). Short durations here correlate with high user regret.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.DiskStats.UserDataDirFreeSpaceMb
histogram.summary: The amount of available space in megabytes on the disk that hosts the current user data directory as reported by SysInfo::AmountOfFreeDiskSpace(user_data_dir). Warning: this histogram was expired from 2025-02-16 to 2025-03-20; data may be missing.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.DiskStats.UserDataDirFreeSpacePercent
histogram.summary: The percentage of available space on the disk that hosts the current user data directory as reported by SysInfo::AmountOfFreeDiskSpace(user_data_dir) / capacity.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.Experimental.AccessibilityModeFlag
histogram.summary: Whether individual accessibility mode flags are set. Recorded with every UMA report to attempt to slice other metrics based on which a11y flags are set.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.Experimental.HasAccessibilityModeFlag
histogram.summary: Whether any accessibility mode flags are set. Recorded with every UMA report to attempt to slice other metrics based on whether a11y is active.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.InputScenarioChanges{InputScenario}
histogram.summary: Logged whenever the Performance Manager input scenario changes away from {InputScenario}, with the reason for the change.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.RegistryStats.FrontEndHeapDebugOptionsOutcome
histogram.summary: The outcome of attempting to read the value of the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE : Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File : FrontEndHeapDebugOptions registry key. Emitted when UMA requests information about the current session (see metrics::MetricsProvider::ProvideCurrentSessionData).

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.RegistryStats.FrontEndHeapDebugOptionsValue
histogram.summary: The value of the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE : Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File : FrontEndHeapDebugOptions registry key. Emitted every time kSuccess is reported to PerformanceManager.RegistryStats.FrontEndHeapDebugOptionsOutcome.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.ResourceQueryTime.{Function}
histogram.summary: The time it takes for a single Resource Attribution query to return results. This slice of the metric covers the {Function} function.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.TabRevisitTracker.TimeToClose2
histogram.summary: Logged everytime a background tab is closed. Records the time in seconds that the tab has spent in the background since it was last active.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.TabRevisitTracker.TimeToRevisit2
histogram.summary: Logged everytime a background tab is revisited. Records the time in seconds that the tab has spent in the background since it was last active.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.TransientKeepAlive.Result
histogram.summary: Recorded when a renderer process's transient keep-alive is resolved. This tracks the final state of the keep-alive attempt, corresponding to the TransientKeepAliveResult enum (e.g., successful reuse, eviction, or timeout).

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.TransientKeepAlive.TimeToReuse
histogram.summary: Recorded only when a process kept alive by the TransientKeepAlivePolicy was successfully reused (i.e., when TransientKeepAliveResult::kReused is recorded in the .Result histogram). Measures the time delta from when the process became empty (and the keep-alive timer started) to when it was reused for a new navigation.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.UserTuning.BatterySaverModeEnabledPercent
histogram.summary: Recorded every UMA upload, this histogram represents the percentage of the interval since the last upload that was spent with Battery Saver enabled.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.UserTuning.EfficiencyMode
histogram.summary:
Logged on each UMA upload to represent which user-controllable Efficiency Mode setting the browser is in during the reported window. If the mode was changed between uploads, MIXED will be reported for that interval.
This histogram is used internally to filter other histograms by efficiency mode.

histogram.name: PerformanceManager.UserTuning.MemorySaverModeEnabledPercent
histogram.summary: Recorded every UMA upload, this histogram represents the percentage of the interval since the last upload that was spent with Memory Saver enabled.
